title: Hamada as an attractive mature man, round 2: four new hairstyles
question: Which of these, if any, should become Hamada's new base portrait? The current portrait can stay as the non-adult version and a pick here would be the Adult-mode look, if you prefer.

media.caption: Pictures: the current portrait, then all 16 renders in order, framed at the game's portrait scale. Round 1 drew the same short spiky hair with grey shaved-looking sides 12 times; this round changes only the hair, one hairstyle per prompt, each one nobody in the cast has: h1 centre part to the jaw, h2 collar-length waves, h3 soft permed curls, h4 slicked straight back. Face, age, suit, scene words and seeds 1 to 4 are as round 1, and shaved sides are excluded on every render. None of the 16 shows grey at the temples. Seed 4 still draws a teal suit.

The 12 renders from seeds 1 to 3 beside Mio, Kenji, Mori and Hamada's current game portraits, at the size the game shows them on a 1080p desktop. Hairstyles already in the cast: Eric's short ponytail, Mori's combed-back side part, Kenji's short messy hair, the guard's bald head, Goro's swept-up white hair, Jun's side-swept fringe.

Face drift from the current portrait ccip 0.079 (a new face is the point). Dashboard #2578. My verdict, rejected: centre part to the jaw as asked, but the face slides back to the tired caricature (heavy eye bags, drooping brows). No grey at the temples.
